name: Adverse media on customer or associates
description: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
fp: Name matches with unrelated individuals and old or unproven allegations are common; confirm identity and source credibility.

links.name: Adverse media on embezzlement or procurement fraud
links.ctx: Credible reporting or enforcement action links the customer or associates to misappropriation of state funds.
links.fp: Media can be politically motivated or inaccurate, especially in repressive jurisdictions.

links.name: Adverse media on customer or associates
links.ctx: Credible negative news links the customer or associated parties to financial crime, corruption or regulatory action.
links.fp: Name matches, old or unproven allegations and unrelated namesakes are common.

links.name: Adverse media or enforcement for IUU activity
links.ctx: Vessel, owner or manager in sanction or prosecution lists.

links.name: Adverse media on illegal logging or enforcement notices
links.ctx: Customer is named in seizure, sanction or investigation news.

links.name: Adverse media or enforcement action over waste crime
links.ctx: Fines, seizures, or investigations tied to firm or owners.

links.name: Adverse media or enforcement links to wildlife trafficking
links.ctx: Customer or associates named in prosecutions, seizures or NGO investigations.

links.name: Payments from or to persons with prior convictions or adverse media relating to child exploitation
links.ctx: Customer appears in credible reports or sanctions of offences against children.
links.fp: Records may be old or mismatched.

links.name: Adverse media or open-source concern about extremist engagement
links.ctx: Customer is named in credible reporting or intelligence-led alerts for extremist advocacy, associations or prior convictions linked to violence.
links.fp: Media can be wrong, outdated or about a namesake; association alone is not proof of funding intent.
